outline.title: Online Complaint & Grievance Management System
outline.summary: Title slide for the college project presentation with subtitle and presenter context.

outline.title: The problem: complaints are difficult to track
outline.summary: Show the institutional pain points created by paper registers and fragmented email workflows.

outline.title: The proposed solution: one accountable workflow
outline.summary: Explain the end-to-end complaint lifecycle from submission through routing, investigation, resolution, and feedback.

outline.title: Four role workspaces, one shared process
outline.summary: Present the responsibilities and permissions of complainants, administrators, department managers, and complaint officers.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/complaint-management-system/docs/screenshots/overview.png; /home/ubuntu/complaint-management-system/docs/screenshots/modules/admin.png; /home/ubuntu/complaint-management-system/docs/screenshots/modules/department.png; /home/ubuntu/complaint-management-system/docs/screenshots/modules/officer.png - Four role workspaces matching Complainant, Administrator, Department Manager, and Complaint Officer UI screens

outline.title: The data model makes the workflow traceable
outline.summary: Explain the core relational entities, governance tables, and GRV reference-number pattern.

outline.title: Security is part of the design
outline.summary: Summarize CSRF, password, role authorization, upload, anonymous complaint, and audit controls.

outline.title: SLA and escalation turn data into action
outline.summary: Show priority-based deadlines, overdue indicators, escalation records, and workload analytics.

outline.title: Reports and communication support institutional review
outline.summary: Show CSV/PDF exports, receipts, notifications, email evidence, and feedback ratings.

outline.title: Testing and automation make the project reproducible
outline.summary: Present the smoke test, CI/CD checks, role matrix, authorization checks, and workflow verification.

outline.title: Deployment and demonstration
outline.summary: Explain Docker deployment, GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages preview, and the academic documentation pack.

outline.title: Conclusion: more than CRUD
outline.summary: Close with the project value, accountability loop, academic readiness, and future integration potential.
